name: branding-business-card-blue-network-node
title: Blue network-node gradient business card
whatItIs: A two-sided business card mockup with a blue gradient front bearing a triangular network-node emblem and connecting-line texture, and a clean white back with teal contact icons.
whatItMeans: A geometric node-and-line emblem functions as an instant, ownable logo mark for a company that hasn't specified an industry beyond 'tech,' making the template broadly reusable.
techniques: build an abstract logo mark from connected dots/lines evoking a data network
split card sides between a bold gradient face and a clean white informational back
use small filled circular icon badges for contact details on the white side for consistency

vocabulary.definition: a logo or graphic motif made of connected points and lines suggesting networking, data or connectivity
